Hi Survivors!

We’ve already implemented the new content for the event with today’s update.
You can now complete missions and enter giveaways to earn boxes from the new and unique [b]Medieval 2025 set[/b].

The overall event starts on [b]July 11th, 2025[/b], and ends on July [b]28th, 2025[/b]. See the detailed schedule below:

[list]
[*]Event loot will spawn in zombie loot
[*]The Medieval 2025 Skinbox will be available through the marketplace, giveaways, contracts, and Twitch Drops
[*]Medieval and Viking clothing will be available in the marketplace
[*]Battle Royale and Competitive modes will feature themed rewards
[*]The Trading Lounge will receive a medieval-themed makeover
[*]PVP will include medieval-themed servers with additional benefits
[/list]

[h2]Twitch Drops[/h2]
[b]11.07.-28.07.2025[/b]
Earn Medieval-themed cosmetics by watching your favorite streamers in the Infestation: The NewZ category on Twitch.
If you experience issues receiving your claimed boxes, try relinking your Twitch account. You can manage your Twitch link here: https://playnewz.com/account

[b]11.07.-28.07.2025[/b]
Climb the seasonal leaderboard for bragging rights and special rewards!
[i]Note: Boosting others to rank up faster is not allowed and may result in all reputation being removed from your character.[/i]

[h2]Double Currency + Experience + Reputation[/h2]
[b]11.07.-28.07.2025[/b]
All earned currency, experience, and reputation will be doubled during the event.
Subscription multipliers will apply as well.

[h2]Free Premium Week[/h2]
[b]14.07.-21.07.2025[/b]
All accounts without Premium will receive full Premium rewards throughout this period.

[h2]Login Reward[/h2]
[b]11.07.-14.07.2025[/b]
Log in between these dates to receive [b]10 Medieval 2025 Skinboxes[/b].
(Time window: 12:00 PM – 12:00 PM CEST)

We’ve also prepared some giveaways across our socials—make sure to follow us everywhere so you don’t miss out!

A special [b]Gold Coin sale[/b] is also coming soon. Stay tuned for more info.

If you have questions about the [b]Arcade contracts[/b] or [b]Survival missions[/b], check out our article here: https://support.playnewz.com/viewarticle?/117-medieval-2025-missions

[h2]See You In-Game![/h2]
Sharpen your swords, gear up, and dive into the action.
We’ll be watching the battles unfold—good luck, Survivors!

Stay connected:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/8174495e062211737e11dcefeabdfed31fef71e8.jpg[/img]

Hey Survivors!

We're planning a small patch and server restart tomorrow, July 11th. Here's what's coming:

[h2]Content[/h2]
[b]Medieval 2025 Event[/b]  
Get ready for the upcoming Medieval 2025 event!
Some event-related content is now live for early access and testing.

[h2]Gameplay Updates[/h2]
[b]Survival Mode Missions[/b]  
New missions have been added to Survival mode as a sneak peek of the upcoming seasonal wipe.
Get in early, explore the changes, and prepare for what's coming!

[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[b]Launcher Update[/b]  
We've released a new launcher to fix issues some players faced during game downloads—such as the "Failed to get information" error. These problems were related to HTTP/HTTPS access. If you had one of these errors, please update your launcher and try again.

[b]Additional Dropped Models (Physics Disabled)[/b]  
We’ve added more dropped item models for cases where players have [b]physics disabled[/b] in-game.
This helps prevent gear from appearing to float or behave oddly when dropped.

Thanks for playing, and stay tuned for the full Medieval 2025 rollout! ⚔️

notes.title: Patch 8.55
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/6282a135b46d1dfc059c61074fb5b81616b33658.jpg[/img]

Hey Survivors!

Tonight, one of our main server providers is performing maintenance, which is estimated to take a maximum of 4 hours.
During this time, all of our servers will be offline. We will use this opportunity to roll out a patch to remove the Valentine theme, along with some bug fixes and changes.

[list]
[*] Removed the Vault NPC from the Arena map for security reasons.
[*]  You will no longer be able to pick up stacks of items that are not stackable in your backpack, such as weapons, skinboxes, etc. Instead, you will pick them up one by one.
[*]  Changed the Lounge to a summer theme.
[*]  Removed Valentine content; for example, contracts will no longer grant the skinbox. This means the Valentine 2025 skinbox is now considered legacy.
[*] Removed finger rewards from the Halloween 2024 contracts and the game.
[/list]
Item rewards have been removed from previous contracts, but you can still complete them to earn XP and currency. These themed contracts are designed to be played and progressed during the event.

We are currently investigating an issue with the flea market feature and have had to disable the GC currency, meaning you won't be able to create new offers using GC.

We hope the maintenance doesn’t take the full 4 hours, but unfortunately, it's out of our hands.

[*]Adjusted the timer and distance of item spawns at helicopter crashes in Survival.[list]

[*]Fixed some building materials that didn't have assigned footstep sounds.[list]
[*]This was mainly happening in any 5-story building in Survival.[/list][/list]

Downtime will be a maximum of 45 minutes, depending on the servers.

notes.title: Survival Mode Update: Wipe & New Beginnings!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/dd5ae79a6605d90ffded5fc8342df82ec9cfbb43.jpg[/img]

Hello Survivors,

We’re excited to announce the upcoming Survival Mode Wipe! This fresh start will bring everyone back to square one, leveling the playing field and offering all players a renewed challenge. Along with the wipe, we’re introducing several key changes to enhance gameplay and keep things exciting.

🌟 [b]What's Changing in Survival Mode? [/b]
The wipe is just the beginning! We’ve made updates across various aspects of Survival Mode to improve balance, and refine the experience. Here’s a preview of what you can look forward to:

[list]
[*]Original Colorado map
[*]Night zombies, which are more dangerous
[*]Limited access to SuperZombies
[*]Improved loot system: each town now offers specific loot based on what you're searching for
[*]Disable skins option
[*]Crafting list reset; we will add more recipes based on player feedback
[*]Contracts removed; we're planning to bring back direct missions
[/list]
[i]*These aren't all changes, just the most important ones.[/i]

[h3][b]Improved Loot System[/b][/h3]
This is an important update, so let me explain it in detail. Essentially, loot spawns are now determined by the number of players on the server. The more players there are, the more loot will spawn.
This change affects both Official and Private servers.

[h3][b]Private Server Loot[/b][/h3]
One of the most frequently asked questions is about loot balancing on private servers. Private servers have a loot debuff compared to Official servers, meaning that 50 players on a private server won’t see the same amount of loot as 50 players on an Official server. However, renting a private server allows you to farm in peace and explore the world without the risk of being attacked by others.

[h3][b]Missions[/b][/h3]
I’d like to move away from the contracts idea, as it doesn’t really fit a survival game.
But let me explain why we introduced contracts in the first place. Contracts are linked to your account, whereas missions you accept and complete on the map are character-based. This means that map missions can only be started and finished by a single character, while contracts can be started and completed by any character within a game mode.
At the moment, there aren’t many missions available. Completing them would have taken more time, so I’ll be preparing an update specifically for missions in the near future.


We hope these updates will create a more dynamic and engaging experience, and we’re excited to see how you adapt to the changes!

Thank you for being part of this adventure. Let’s dive into Survival Mode’s fresh start together!

- Team Fredaikis

notes.title: Survival Reset: Rise from the Ashes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/ca7c7fb2689cff6713ae83401454ad6cae53469f.jpg[/img]
Hello Survivors!

We are here to bring you some exciting news!
We've made our decision on the date for the Survival Reboot and its upcoming wipe!

[b]The official date for the wipe and server reopening is November 9th, 2024! This will happen right after our Halloween event ends![/b]

When the time comes, the servers will go down briefly for a quick patch. During this time, we will also perform the wipe on SURVIVAL to prepare it for release right after!

Afterward, everything in [b]Survival[/b] will be wiped. This includes characters, clans, territories, and more. However, [b]all cosmetic items and options you have already acquired will remain intact.[/b]

Now, let’s go over some details in more depth!

[h3]Are we wiping every game mode?[/h3]
No. None of the other game modes will be affected; this wipe will only impact Survival.

[h3]Is anything from my account going to be lost?[/h3]
Only your [b]SURVIVAL[/b] characters and [b]SURVIVAL[/b] GI will be wiped. Everything account-based will remain untouched.

[h3]Will we get anything back from the wiped items?[/h3]
Last time we attempted item returns, it caused more harm than good. This time, there will be no return of any items to Survival.

[h3]What about my cosmetic items and active cosmetics?[/h3]
Those are part of your account; they are ACCOUNT ITEMS/ASSETS. This means they will not be wiped.
Your skins, character models, sprays, and spawn protections—your [b]account assets—will remain[/b].
Additionally, [b]account items like skin boxes and skin recipes will not be removed[/b].

[h3]How long will the first 'season' last?[/h3]
There is no ETA for this as it’s the first 'season', and we need to analyze data before making a final decision.

With that in mind, expect our patch on [b]09/11/2024[/b] to take a bit longer. If you have any questions or want to join the discussion, please join us [b][url=https://discord.gg/thenewz][b]on Discord[/b][/url][/b].

For the full announcement on upcoming Survival changes, check out our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/226700?emclan=103582791433847530&emgid=4669759808361825796]Official Announcement[/url].
If you need assistance with any issues, please open a [url=https://support.playnewz.com/][b]support ticket[/b][/url].

notes.title: Survival Changes for Upcoming Wipe
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/20d89d2ccfee236f173c83fa1edef89702f3ca09.png[/img]

[h1]Infestation: The New Beginning[/h1]

As most of you know, we have been preparing significant changes for our game, specifically the Survival Game Mode. However, in this case, instead of innovating, we will be returning to the basics—what has worked in the past and what the community has been clamoring for!
 
[h3][b]Why is Survival being rebooted?[/b][/h3]
After several attempts at introducing new elements to Survival, your feedback has shown us what should remain unchanged in order to preserve the feeling we had when we played [i]The War Z[/i] and [i]Survivor Stories[/i] back in the day, and what can be kept from the recent changes. With that in mind, we have decided to recreate the game as it was—ambiance, loot rarity, mechanics, etc.—while retaining only the well-known and unquestionable improvements we've made since then. This, however, will be our starting point.

[h3]Post changes to it[/h3]
From that point on, any changes we decide to make will be based solely on suggestions and polls from active Survival players. These polls will not lead to direct or immediate changes. One key consideration is that a 51% approval in polls will not be considered a sufficient majority. We need to assess whom the changes will affect and how they will impact those people. Therefore, we will require a larger margin for approval. We also aim to structure the polls in a straightforward manner, including an option like 'doesn't matter to me' to minimize the potential for larger groups to manipulate the results.

The goal of the new Survival mode is to ensure FUN for EVERYONE. Changes that could negatively impact a significant portion of the community, or that are controversial and divisive, may be rejected. 

[h2]Initial Plans for Survival[/h2]
Our initial plans are based on the feedback we've received so far from the community, who are eager to experience a true Survival mode, reminiscent of what [i]Infestation[/i]/[i]The War Z[/i] once was.

[h3]Seasons[/h3]
We will structure the game mode into seasons, following a classic seasonal system with wipes occurring at set intervals to keep the game fresh and the community engaged. Our initial plan is for seasons to last 6 to 9 months, but we need to assess whether that works for most players. To determine the ideal season length, we will run the first season without a fixed end date. This will allow us to observe how far players progress into the endgame and how long it takes before they no longer have anything left to do.

[h3]Maps[/h3]
We will have only ONE map available at all times, and the same map will be used across both Official and Private Servers. There may be maps for specific TEMPORARY events with different rules, etc. Missions will also be available throughout the season, though at the beginning, they will be more limited. There will be fewer missions initially, as they can greatly impact player progression. To achieve the right balance, we need to observe how the game mode feels without excessive 'boosts' to progression and the economy.

[h3]Skins[/h3]
Skins are a very controversial aspect of Survival. There are a few things we need to address, but we believe we’ve found a fair balance.

First, let’s talk about clan skins. Clans with existing clan skins can request to have them re-added to the new Survival mode. This can only be done by the current clan leader, who must have a character and clan created in the Game Mode.

Second, and most importantly: Skins are optional! While everyone knows you can choose not to use skins, that doesn’t stop others from using them. With that in mind, we’ve introduced a new system that allows you to disable all item skins in your game.

So, even if a player has a skin equipped, you won’t see it if you’ve enabled this option. However, if you enable the option and have a skin equipped yourself, even though you won’t see the skin, others who haven’t enabled this option will still be able to see it.

[h3]Loot[/h3]
Another major change to the game mode will be the loot system. We’re going back to basics, removing many of the new gun additions (which we may reintroduce gradually later). The goal is to recreate the loot system as it was in the past, both in terms of rarity and placement, along with the quirky randomness we all remember. Who doesn’t recall finding a Mauser SP66 in a small-town supermarket?

However, on both Official and Private Servers, we’ve added a new system where the more players are connected to the server, the more loot will spawn. This system was introduced to ensure Private Servers don’t provide excessive advantages over Official Servers, while still making Private Servers appealing since you have the entire server to yourself. 

[h3]Zombies[/h3]
Zombies are going back to basics, with Super Zombies being the only 'supers' available. They will no longer spawn 24/7 as they do now, but will only appear at certain times of the day (in-game time).

Additionally, we’ve introduced zombie variations during nighttime, along with an increased number of zombies. These nighttime zombies will also grant players more EXP and XP.

[h3]General Changes[/h3]
In addition to the option to disable skins, we are also removing the option to disable shadows. With today’s hardware, shadows have minimal impact on performance, and the only reason to disable them is to make the game easier. We're going against that, as we want to maintain the element of surprise and encourage furtive, stealthy gameplay, especially in cities.

Another small but important change we've made is that, even if you have physics disabled, dropped items will no longer float and obstruct players' view.

Additionally, the overgrowth on buildings has been fixed and redone in certain areas to prevent abusive behavior.

[h3]Official Dates and Times[/h3]

[b]We will provide more details, including dates, times, and in-depth information, soon, so stay tuned![/b]

Join our discussion on our discord server [url=https://discord.gg/thenewz]CLICK HERE[/url]

notes.title: Christmas Calendar - Xmas Events kickoff!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It is with great pleasure that we bring you once again our traditional "Xmas Calendar" event!
Starting on December 1st, 2023 we will open the calendar for you to collect unique items that cannot be gotten anywhere else or in any other way, in addition to classic Xmas-themed items! All free for Premium users!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/cbf91fd2ddd374db0f1a99bffbcb93fe90aa6fa8.png[/img]

[b]How does it work?
[/b]When the event is LIVE, at 12AM on December 1st, you will be able to access our Advent Calendar page [url=https://playnewz.com/advent]HERE[/url]!

Everyday there will be an item available for you to collect! Just click on that day's item while logged in to your account and you will automatically receive the item on your account! 

[i]Keep in mind, though: If you miss one day, you will [b]NOT [/b]be able to get that reward again! So don't forget to visit the page every single day!
[/i]
And remember, during the month of December, we will start the official Xmas Event with many different events spread out for you to get even more free stuff!

Don't miss out and have a merry Christmas and happy holidays!

notes.title: Oceania Servers UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/10c97c6062c1f4424255eca86c0a7a7b7fca47d5.jpg[/img]

[h3]Oceania Servers will be taken down. [/h3]

Dear players,
Due to the recent and upcoming increase in electricity prices for our provider, the prices for the servers have also been raised substantially in the last few months and will continue on the rise on the upcoming months. 
Since our contract renewal is coming up soon, we have made the decision to shut down our servers there for the foreseeable future as a way to prevent it from forcing us to also raise our prices in that specific region on [b]October 1st, 2023[/b]. 
That, combined with the low demand of private servers in the region and the low amount of players at peak times in that region, we thought this would be the best course of action. 

For everyone who currently has a server in our Oceania server, you can request a move to any other region by submitting a ticket at http://support.playnewz.com/ 

Thank you for understanding

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/4e86e153041de24e56501530b0b6dc3cef078af8.png[/img]

[h3]BOX HUNTING EVENT[/h3]

Hello Survivors,

This weekend we will be doing a very different and special event!
We will be placing lockboxes with a password around servers in all regions with some cosmetic items for you to find!
Now here's the catch: They will be placed in Arcade Official Servers. Which means, not only do you have to find them, but you will need to get out ALIVE. 
No special rules apply to this event - If you find it, put in the password and get out with it, it's yours. 
If someone else finds it and you kill them, their loot is ALL yours!

Start: [b]05.05.2023, 1:00 PM CEST[/b]
End: [b]08.05.2023, 1:00 PM CEST[/b]

Each locker will have these skinboxes and will NOT be replenished. So you might find it, put in the password and they'll be empty!

5 Lockboxes will be placed in one server per region in Arcade.

They are placed in all [b]Colorado 001 Servers[/b], for each region.

In each of the servers, they will be placed in the same 5 locations, BUT NOT THE SAME SPOTS!

So for example, and I will use this an example as this will not be one of the locations (this is your first hint, wink wink): There is a box that is in Clearview, which could the direct hint. Now, they will all be placed inside the Police Station. BUT they won't be placed in the same exact room every time. One could be in the cell, the other in the office, the other right outside by the police cars.

Our hints may be extremely direct - with the name of the city/town OR they can have just an indication, a pun, a reference to the area, so just read carefully!

So here we go... The HINTS for each lockboxes are the following: 

#1 - Campos - Yes, that's the only hint. ANYWHERE in the whole city!
#2 - It seems as if it was a safezone before, but it's not anymore. Keep driving south;
#3 - Boulder City - Also anywhere in the whole city;
#4 - A vintage PVP spot that had a map of its own made;
#5 - There was a huge fire here;

And the password for the lockers is: 23fentotsi0a2in

Happy Hunting!

notes.title: Infestation: The New Beginning!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/7855f901c62ed5c19bb3103f4b639d614c66e0eb.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone, 

After running polls and pondering a lot about the subject we have decided to listen to the majority of players and we have decided to start anew with Survival and start it with Seasons. What that means is that everything from Survival will be wiped. Character stats, Inventories, EXP, and so forth. You must be asking yourselves, "is this just a random wipe?"... The answer is no. With the wipe, some things will change and the dynamic of Survival will also shift, for the better. 

Here again, are the results of the 2 polls we did:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/75ca288efb0e54282718ae1c289e6e722670d25b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/f68bf34f07bb74c1c73414f5421c61f9638b4d1e.jpg[/img]


[b][h3]Seasonal Wipes [/h3][/b]From this point forth, you can be 100% there will be a wipe, which will be accompanied by leaderboards with unique rewards every single season. We feel that as it is right now, it just doesn't match the gaming community's dynamic anymore. Spending more time looting than playing is not a direction it should be going anymore. With seasonal wipes and leaderboards, players will have a reason to not just try to hoard and hoard items, instead of collecting items for PVP. 
Our overall plan is, to tell you exactly the start and end of a "wipe", but right now we can not do that. We simply have to check the first couple of wipes, how quickly the community reaches the "end game" and adjust everything.
Also, keep in mind, characters are going to stay since they are linked to clans and some of these have clan cosmetics. You also don't have to worry about your cosmetics, we won't touch these.


[b][h3]Loot[/h3][/b] Though last time we tried to do it this way, it just didn't feel right in the end, so we will be redoing all the loot from scratch, removing the items that were added at later times to the game. So basically, items will be mostly similar to I:SS in similar places. 
Overall we will try to implement a new system, which means loot will be town-based. This way if we wanna change something in Clearview, the rates in Campos won't change. 
And with the next topic, you will see more of a cleaning of loot to make it easier to go through looting in a more logical matter. Crafting is going to take a huge hit and that's a good thing! We have noticed that the crafting of items is not used by the great majority of players as items can spawn that have similar effects with much less effort. With that in mind, we will be removing most of the crafting recipes and moving them closer to what you could craft simple bandages, improved melee items, etc. 
We will also be adding some of the newer items we have from crafting, but to make them more unique and worth the time. 
This will not only make it easier to understand and more appealing to players, but it will clean up the loot tables for items that can be used on the go! 


More details like the start and other things are going to be announced in a separate announcement. We are going to take our time and try to make everything as good as possible, NO RUSH this time.
How you could help us? Spread this information and it will be more worth than gold!

We do have a dev feed on our discord server where we inform our community about small goals we reached and critical updates. Don't forget to check it out [url=https://discord.gg/thenewz]DISCORD[/url]

Respectfully,
The Fredaikis Team

notes.title: Viking Event 2022 Overview
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/820985dbfe3f7344e987ce678653439f2e201648.jpg[/img]

For the following weeks, from the [b]24th of June[/b] to the [b]11th of July, 2022[/b] we will be running our [b]Viking Event[/b]!

During this event we will be running limited-time events that will reward you with character clothes, skins and even GC!

[h3][b]- Missions/Contracts that will be reward the exclusive Viking 2022 Skinbox.[/b][/h3]
Find the contracts and complete them as many times as you want to get the rewards. More information can be found [url=https://support.playnewz.com/viewarticle?/87-viking-2022-event]HERE[/url]

[h3][b]- Twitch Drops ([url=https://support.playnewz.com/viewarticle?/84-twitch-drop-event-rules]Rules[/url])[/b][/h3]
During these events, by Streaming under [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Infestation%3A%20The%20New%20Z]Infestation: The New Z[/url], you will have Drops Enabled automatically.
You can also watch streams and receive Skinboxes and some additional themed cosmetics!
Make sure you have your account linked to Twitch!

[h3][b]- Seasonal Leaderboards[/b][/h3]
Fight to the top of the leaderboards and receive rewards at the end of the event!

[h3][b]- Double EXP[/b][/h3]
You can also take this time to level up your character and get the full skill tree during the event whenever Double EXP is enabled

[h3][b]- Double Currency[/b][/h3]
Get that money, be it in Arcade, Survival, Battle Royale or Competitive! 

[h3][b]- Double Rewards[/b][/h3]
Game modes that have an endgame reward, like Battle Royale and Competitive will grant you double the rewards!

[h3][b]- Return of limited items at the store![/b][/h3]
We will also be bringing back some additional cosmetics from the previous Viking Event during this event! They will NEVER be back again, though!

[h3][b]- Free Premium Weekend[/b][/h3]
We will have a weekend where everyone will automatically have Premium on their accounts.

notes.title: Patch 5.8
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/223a55cba548b526e1d646d6e27ab51e25f21ee1.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,

We are bringing a new Patch for Infestation: The New Z with some fixes and some new additions to the game, reworking existing vehicles and adding new ones.

[h3][b]Patch date: 17.05.2022, ~10 AM CET[/b][/h3]

[h2]GENERAL[/h2]
[list][*]Added a new Truck to the game. It has 8 seats and it has 10 slots in the trunk for storing items. 
[*]Added the Ambulance to the game. It has 4 seats and it has 12 slots in the trunk for storing items. 
[*]Police, Sheriff Dragstar, and the Ambulance will have their horns sound.
[*]Reworked the Police Dragster.
[*]Reworked the Sheriff Dragster.[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/cb8083a99b0486f30c7ab7bd31c8d89ea923361d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/b8600f48527bbfbb15fe1c0060bfb9ce9057b4e5.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/15e87ff69d21182d29825a2bb2530554fee84a93.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/a3d600372f5c81a56e39171e416327008e7d199e.png[/img][/url]

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed a bug that caused vehicles to act weird when a player sat in the driver seat while passengers were inside. 
[*]Fixed a bug with a sound that was caused by joining a server when someone nearby was in a vehicle. 
[*]Fixed a desync of players sitting inside a vehicle after someone joins the server.
[*]Fixed a problem that caused players to appear sitting next to the vehicle after rejoining the server.
[*]Fixed a miscalculation of the gained XP in Battle Royale. The multiplier per minute did work properly.
[/list]

[h3][b]CONTRACTS[/b][/h3]
[h3][i]The Valentine 2022/Halloween 2021 Event Contracts and Missions will be interrupted and will not work anymore, starting from Patch [b]5.9[/b][/i].[/h3]
We have made some changes to the names on the previously released contracts to make it easier to understand them. They will contain on the title what game modes, PVE/PVP, and if it's weapon restricted. 
Here's an example:
[b]Old[/b]: [i]Weekend PVE AC Contract 1[/i]
[b]New[/b]: [i][b][AC][PVE][/b] Weekend Contract 1[/i]

We are also increasing the Account/Season XP gained from Weekend Contracts:

[i][AC][PVE] Weekend Contract 1:[/i] [strike]700[/strike] -> [b]1400[/b]
[i][AC][PVE] Weekend Contract 2:[/i] [strike]500[/strike] -> [b]1000[/b]
[i][AC][PVE] Weekend Contract 3:[/i] [strike]600[/strike] -> [b]1200[/b]
[i][AC][AR][PVE] Weekend Contract 1:[/i] [strike]300[/strike] -> [b]600[/b]
[i][AC][AR][PVE] Weekend Contract 2:[/i] [strike]350[/strike] -> [b]750[/b]
[i][AC][AR][PVE] Weekend Contract 3:[/i] [strike]470[/strike] -> [b]1050[/b]

We are also increasing the Currency Reward for a few contracts, as follows: 

[i][AC][AR][PVP] Weekend Contract 4:[/i] [strike]18.000[/strike] -> [b]31.000[/b]
[i][AC][AR][PVP] Weekend Contract 5:[/i] [strike]28.000[/strike] -> [b]48.000[/b]
[i][AC][AR][PVP] Weekend Contract 6:[/i] [strike]50.000[/strike] -> [b]75.000[/b]

[h3]NEW CONTRACTS[/h3]
[list][*]We are also bringing a lot of new contracts which will be released throughout this period.[/list]
ARCADE:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/70e226c1cf9dc47c6cc53b9ac0ceb598ec33fe40.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/5f7ee54b6b49630c8eef21c541ac83760072c4fd.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/3049f324e6f7d92780bc634ce33a9f3df8c90214.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/3e584e3395afc13551bd8de4ed1c50ee62440ce4.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/b5045503825c086901ae3e95002042d12199da13.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/53a54aa1aa3ea6161c9e1d771e9120f028e6e110.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/f8fb1f6ab9b330c05ffda98eae661a74de20a66c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/e118c153e599885f0dc06bc1132015f4b13cae30.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/c4929f0d0d50321b6f12af0adfca9e0a0f9cbcf0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/facc9036827e4769d2ecfad925108bb983a1caa0.png[/img][/url]
SURVIVAL:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/1814786dd4920d9543c2dead77bc543fbe8bff07.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/e1d2dae0a6f7bcbf42cc82e6656ecb4ab58a9388.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/e8356b5eeca27ab15c08edd29ba799ef9b61b9bf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/6409d139de8f4702148aad11dafe89b8497a3e6d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/36e855bbfb092812c9e5ed6efd1d42c04f1303b2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/9445a5414b923110b94bd021a26a1b64e1b8f758.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/3ea58a40c9874d9d121d8b5b0dcbaf90e01722d1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/47dfb326490aaf66a0efede65055cfce6d07a483.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/8afce98a3b9e112b5e2ecf23872d34a78817c286.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/354426287f98901a581c4cd1f5f2d8de595baeac.png[/img][/url]


[b]FIXES[/b]
[list][*]Fixed the Alien IBA. It didn't glow like the other skins on the set.
[*]Easter 2022 Skinboxes and skins have been marked as Legacy. 
[*]Easter 2022 Contracts and Mission items have also been marked as Legacy. 
[*]Valentine 2022 Missions and Contracts will stop working starting on Patch 5.9
[*]Updated the Iraq Riot Shield.
[*]Updated the Saudi Arabia Riot Shield.
[i]We were made aware that since the Riot Shield contains the word Allah, it was considered offensive to followers of the religion to be shot. So we changed these two Riot Shields to remove the texts mentioning Allah on them.[/i]
[*]Fixed the eye on a character that would show the wrong texture.
[*]Fixed the PVP Map Contracts. 
[*]Lowered the timer of Radiation Zone on Private Servers. You'd better hurry from now on. 
[/list]




[h2][i]NOTE: We are aware of the situation of some countries not having access to their email address providers anymore. If so, please contact us through the support email.[/i][/h2]

Once again thank you for your great support! Want to support us even more? Make sure to share these updates with your friends and followers!

If you'd like to share suggestions and ideas you have for the game please let us know at https://support.playnewz.com/suggestions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/c2d002cb8c8aab8bcd187c412f019356648fd77a.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,
We are happy to announce a new patch in the game!
This new patch has some important fixes, especially when it comes to quality of life. That includes fixes to how the Mission System reads and computes items required for them, improvements on vehicle issues, and some new features like a different hitmarker on an enemy with Spawn Protection and First-Person crosshair!

[h2]GENERAL CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:[/h3][list]
[*]Picking up mission items in stacks should now properly count. 
[*]Grabbing required items from your stash or item boxes will also progress properly for the missions. [*]Fixed a bug where you could get kicked after getting off a vehicle.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Auto Skin system that happened in Battle Royale when picking up a K. Style Helmet during the round or the Warmup lobby. 
[*]Fixed the model of the Competitive v2 skinbox.
[*]Fixed some map errors on the Tutorial map.
[*]Fixed some players spawn in Caliwood and Colorado on Arcade.
[*]Added a new indicator if you shoot an enemy that has spawn protection. You will get now a light-blue hitmarker.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/3666eb0c08dd12238ab13c715aac55d787353d8c.png[/img]
[*]Added an option to enable your crosshair in First Person. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/007f4a52393d2fd9b9af053984e638f43a3d0390.png[/img]
[/list]

During Easter month ([b]12.04.2022 - 25.04.2022[/b]) we will be holding special events for short periods. 
Those events include and are not limited to:
[list]
[*] Double XP/currency/reputation
[*] Twitch Stream Events
[*] Special Weekend Events 
[*] [b][i]and more![/i][/b]
[/list]
We will also release a new set of Easter-themed missions and activities. 
[list]
[*] Missions exclusive to PvP.
[*] Missions on both game modes
[*] Themed rewards in Battle Royale and Competitive.
[*] New missions with new items.
[*] A new backpack with some skin variations to celebrate Easter
[*] [i][b]And more![/b][/i]
[/list]
[i][b]For more information on the event missions, click [url=https://support.playnewz.com/viewarticle?/86-easter-event-contracts]HERE[/url]![/b][/i]

[b]More information about the event will come soon in a separate announcement.[/b]

notes.title: Patch 5.6
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/f23692f1f931f53e57664b66b85a22c865b9447d.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,
We are bringing a small patch to address a few issues and some fixes for you. Half of the changes came live last week when we had the urgent hotfix.


[h2]GENERAL CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:[/h3][list]
[*]Redesigned the Airport Tower. As whatever was done, players found a way to abuse it. We have now completely removed the middle of it, so it's open!
[*]Adjusted the Account/Season XP gained in some unbalanced contracts.
[*]Fixed the contract [i][b]Weekend Contract 3[/b][/i] where zombie kills did not properly count. 
[*]Fixed a crash that happened while moving and the item name was rotating in the inventory (when you hover over the item and the text is too long). 
[*]Fixed a bug in the animation that gave players an unfair advantage when throwing grenades and being stuck on that animation.
[*]Renamed the [i]Airdrop Caller GD[/i] to [i]Airdrop Caller Normal[/i], since it can also be purchased with other game mode currencies.
[*]Fixed the Airdrop Caller Normal in your inventory when you received one in both game modes at the same time. That could cause desyncs. 
[*]Adjusted the physics of the garage building in all maps and game modes.
[*]Added a legacy icon on items or contracts which are from the previous events. This icon means these contracts might not work anymore since the event is over.
[*]Improved the mission system overview - It now shows in proper order.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/2d98b497c8a3aa801b81fd390eff45dc4a2b35de.png[/img]
[/list]
[h2]SURVIVAL[/h2]
[h3]FIXES & ADDITIONS:[/h3][list]
[*]Fixed some loot crates that had no loot inside.
[*]Added some areas around the hangers to give players the ability to use the areas better. 
[*]Added more openings on the south side of the Airport to give players a better way to enter the fight. 
[*]Added more cover around the airport to give players a way to push in a safer matter. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/2e0a49ca682e905ee29e0d839270040381b78149.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/927753d4c9f9860dfbdbdc4fbcca04cce2cc27c4.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/4284c716a17fb4b541bbc3f874d3504dae7ec425.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/812218d998125851100151883d18ef2bf7cfc385.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/8c2871a1ffa9b4b1ce8e434d7903953b39c1c74f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/6d33986ea083427334af89080ca48231b4189c23.png[/img][/url]
[*]Decreased the cooldown of the wood shield barricades.
[*]Added a new crafting recipe. You can now craft rope out of cloth.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/53d25cbe60e897cc98e44051c830a56b97bb5d92.png[/img]
[*]Rank 1 and Rank 2-10 Skins for the leaderboards should be now working in Survival and Competitive.

[/list]
[h2]ARCADE[/h2]
[h3]FIXES & ADDITIONS:[/h3][list]
[*]Fixed some spawns around Colorado that would make players spawn inside objects. 
[*]Removed some undesired objects left over from the Xmas event.
[*]Changed the Trading Lounge to the Summer version.
[*]The Arena map is now daytime only. 
[*] Valentine contract exchange is be possible again on the Trading Lounge.
[/list]

[h2]BATTLE ROYALE[/h2]
[h3]FIXES & ADDITIONS:[/h3][list]
[*]Fixed a bug where you would keep buffs after ending a match and starting a new one.
[*][i]We are working on contracts for Battle royale right now. More information will come soon.[/i]
[/list]

[h3][b]COMMUNITY POLL[/b][/h3]
[b]MOTO HELMET:[/b]
As we mentioned on the last patch, we ran a poll about the Moto Helmet becoming an item on its own. 
Whoever had a recipe for the regular Moto Helmet, received 1.000.000 GD for each recipe.

[*]New kinds of contracts will get added to the contract boxes in Arcade and Survival.

[/list]

We hope you like the latest changes and enjoy the grind!

notes.title: Patch 5.5
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36854961/63eed7a4768bdf8366d76ba1b8c99294fac49181.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,
We are bringing another patch for you guys that will bring content for the next global event!
We are also making major corrections to the AI and Quality of Life towards them, along with engine corrections to improve overall performance for both game client and server. These will also allow us more leeway to create new features.
And we are adding a handy visual update to show you when you receive EXP and Season Pass XP.

[h2]GENERAL CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with Ridgeway Airport walls and its physics where people were able to abuse them.
[*]Fixed issues in the Polish localization of the game. 
[*]Fixed an issue with Halloween contracts not giving the intended amount of rewards.
[*]Fixed a building model in Campos City and other towns around Colorado. 
[*]Fixed the LOD of the Airport Towers. It now should render properly. 
[*]Fixed an issue that caused a Disconnect during the Warmup in Competitive.
[*]Changed one Official Server to PvE (Both Arcade and Survival) due to poll results. 
[/list]
[h3]COSMETICS[/h3]
[b]NEW:[/b][list]
[*]Added a completely new and reworked [b]Battle Royale[/b] skinset.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/7b3d612d1d0f287c43bfa15b81e5ddbc895b482e.png[/img]
[/list]
[b]FIXES AND CHANGES:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the Store Icon for the [i][b]G36 Battle Royale[/b][/i] Skin
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/30d9b2088b864efd0982b05576fad5cfafb3fbc0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/fd31e20f04e2c0793b5d70991f5554e510f5abef.png[/img][/url]
[*]Reworked the [b]SWAT Armor[/b]. There were some cases of performance problems with it for some players.
[*]Improved the icons for the [b]Crossbow[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/e3a95e3d6a07abed44ba286bed76a5e50c0bcf80.jpg[/img]
[*]Reworked the icons for the [b]B92[/b] and all of its skins. 
[*]Reworked the [b]Hunter Backpack[/b]. It should now fit the character model better.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/3b6781e12c8613896b92a2a8158af0e8bbdaf52d.jpg[/img]
[*]Improved the [b]Heavy Armor Cupido[/b] model.
[*]Improved the [b]Heavy Armor Solari[/b] model.
[*]Improved the [b]Heavy Armor Unicorn[/b] model.
[/list]
[h2]SURVIVAL[/h2]
[h3]FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*]We made changes and moved around the walls around Ridgeway Airport (Colorado) to prevent glitching.
[*]Fixed a bug where Bus Stops wouldn't work properly in Beginner Servers. 
[/list]
[h2]ARCADE[/h2]
[h3]FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed some player spawns in Colorado that could cause players to spawn inside objects.
[*]Removed all the Christmas Event content from the Trading Lounge.
[/list]
[h2]BATTLE ROYALE[/h2]
[h3]FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the kill count to be reset when revived. 
[*]Fixed a visual bug that an item could persist (only visually) from the Warmup to the Match. 
[/list]
[h2]COMMUNITY POLL[/h2]
[h3]MOTO HELMET:[/h3]
[list]
[*]We ran an in-game poll about making the Moto Helmet an item on its own. Right now it's a skin for the K. Style Helmet which doesn't make a lot of sense. The stats are going to be the same and the change is planned for Patch 5.6.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/ccdb07c74bdef507f7f2242ac92ee9e6d72ec718.png[/img]
[/list]

The patch time will be today, 10.02.2022 at around 1:00 PM CET.


Once again thank you for your great support! Want to support us even more? Make sure to share these updates with your friends and followers!

If you'd like to share suggestions and ideas you have for the game please let us know at https://support.playnewz.com/suggestions

notes.title: Server Price Change - GC on Flea Market - Twitch Linkage
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors!

We have made 2 important changes and 1 quality of life change to the game.

The first major change is going to be on the flea market. Normally you could sell and buy items for GD (Game Dollars) or SD (Survival Dollars) but now we have also enabled GC (Gold Coins), our Premium Currency, as an option.

How does it work? The same way how you sell or buy items for other currency.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/87ceb0daa28b96ce8c6809017c09294969fa1f4f.png[/img]

The only difference is, you have to switch currency by pressing the little arrow next to the currency icon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/3c5aa271005d1c319d3db2d903db0bb463637eea.png[/img]

[i]Right now we plan on having it online for a couple of weeks and leave it permanently if everything works fine.[/i]


The second big change goes to the private servers. We made an adjustment towards the basic prices by lowering everything by around 40%. We will keep monitoring how it will go with the number of rented servers and this can be adjusted if necessary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/fe378d5a5496ff37a7a9b46a8ca93c36bed37680.png[/img]


Now we also finally added a button in your account management page on our website, where you can unlink your Twitch account by yourself without contacting support. This will hopefully make it easier for the players to control their linkages.
https://playnewz.com/account

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/5951aed62b7439be8a7f6cbcf35fe038f3c14523.png[/img]


We hope you like the changes and feedback is more than welcome.

We wish everyone a great weekend!

notes.title: Weekend Event - Reworked
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/ce5ef5625fdcd31ab5f811983c294078b3be3df6.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

We come to you today with the news of the Weekend Event rework. 
Though it is a simple thing, it has become an issue and something unattractive to players, so we decided to rethink our approach to it. 
With that in mind, we will not be bringing any Weekend Events this weekend!
But it is not going to be gone completely per se as we will be bringing other events, just not on fixed times on Weekends. 

[b][h3]What is wrong with it now?
[/h3][/b]What we can currently do on Weekend Events are limited and therefore deemed boring by the community, in addition to making people miss out on them and pretty much limiting players to have to choose one event in one game mode. For example, if we have Super Airdrops enabled in Arcade and Sniper-Only Battle Royale matches, that would make players have to choose between participating in one or the other.
Plus, when we have especial events, such as the latest Christmas Events, they tend to repeat themselves and make them feel less special than they should. 

[b][h3]What will replace it?
[/h3][/b]The new events will always happen on weekends, but not necessarily exclusively on the weekends or every weekend. Some may start on Wednesday and end on Sunday or Monday, or start on Tuesday and end the next Monday, etc... 
That way we are able to make them a bit more complex, give more people a chance of participating in them, regardless of their personal schedules. 
For example, we can run a simple GD Skinbox drop event in Survival from Thursday to Monday, then parallel to that, a Twitch Drops event with a new skinbox from Wednesday to Sunday and a Double Reward in Battle Royale from Monday to Saturday. All that in one week, overlapping (or not), making it better for people to also participate in events in different game modes, opposite to how it was before. 

[b][h3]When are the new events going to start?
[/h3][/b]In the beginning, we will be testing the waters with traditional and popular events during these dates and we will start expanding them and trying to create more complex events for more fun in different game modes. 

Thank you for your time!

If you have any questions or discussion points, you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/thenewz]Discord[/url]

If you'd like to share suggestions and ideas you have for the game please let us know at https://support.playnewz.com/suggestions

To stay updated regarding the patch and server downtime please follow us on our social media:

notes.title: Patch 5.3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/dadd53af98e76bbe0eb7eac1eaaf3412b97d6fe5.jpg[/img]

Hello Survivors!
On this patch we are bringing a few quality of life changes that have been both suggested and requested for a while and also some fixes for some smaller errors/bugs in the game. 

[h2]GENERAL CHANGES[/h2]
[h3][b]CLAN MANAGEMENT UPDATE[/b][/h3]
With this update, we are introducing a rework for the clan section. It is a complete overhaul that will see more options on your clan. 
This has been asked for a while and though we wanted to work on this earlier, we had more pressing priorities. 
Clan creation was one of the first features brought under the original developer team in The War Z, but it was lackluster. We have put off doing this complete rework for some time as we didn't feel it was that urgent as, though it was too "plain", it worked for its purpose. 
However, we decided recently to start working on QOL changes such as this to make it even easier to understand for all players, new and old. 

Here are some of the changes made to it:
To access the new Clan Menu, you can find it here:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/a87ae828b0b02ce309cc9a99fcfe0df1cad15e08.jpg[/img]

On this menu, you can see all clans and their public information. 
You can also use the sort tabs to better navigate
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/ca7c8b59900e783350b126d379be77a63530d53c.jpg[/img]

Clicking on a clan will show you all the public information on the clan, as such
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/80adf919e81a34e6d4e28361aca97e3df5c1a5bc.jpg[/img]

Clicking on your clan on the top left will bring up a slightly different menu, with all the known functions you already had in addition to the Customize button:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/1332e749eeb40ad61230b46d2065590d48900292.jpg[/img]

On the Customization menu, you will be able to edit your clan icon, name, description and tag color.
With the clan tag color, you can also pick any RGB color from the menu that pops up:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/7b388f8d949da030c70d7f0fa0ad091c1f98561a.jpg[/img]

[h3]GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Using a Transport will no longer switch off your weapon (changing to barehands).
[*]Fixed an issue with the group list health bars. 
[*]Fixed a language pack issue on Battle Royale Airdrops.
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing stamina desync with the server, causing crashes.
[*]Fixed a UI issue that would cause the value of the discount on subscriptions not show properly.
[*]Added Lobby MVP back to Battle Royale.
[*]Fixed a minor issue in the Event Map server that would cause a bug that prevented accepting group invites in a very specific sequence of events.
[*]Respawning to a Clan Territory will put that spawn on cooldown for 5 minutes.
[/list]
[h3]OBJECTS AND ITEMS[/h3]
[list]
[*]Updated the Collision around the Airport in Colorado to avoid glitching through.
[*]We have reverted the Airport Tower back to the original one. We found some issues with the updated version that was causing many texture bugs. 
[*]Fixed the Adventure Backpack Desion Skin.
[*]Fixed a material error on all M200 models.
[/list]


Once again thank you for your great support! Want to support us even more? Make sure to share these updates with your friends and followers!

If you'd like to share suggestions and ideas you have for the game please let us know at https://support.playnewz.com/suggestions

notes.title: Patch 5.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/fb22fc5482054951b644aef86819ed6df9c2cc65.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone,
We are bringing another patch for you guys that will bring content for the next global event!
We are also making major corrections to the AI and Quality of Life towards them, along with engine corrections to improve overall performance for both game client and server. These will also allow us more leeway to create new features.
And we are adding a handy visual update to show you when you receive EXP and Season Pass XP. 

[h2][b]GENERAL CHANGES[/b][/h2]
[b][h3]GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause the AI's to not hit the zombies in the head in Survival. 
[*] Added the bandit camps to the minimap and the compass.
[*] Made improvements to the transport system (Bus, Clan Points, Safe Zone Shuttles) camera animation. 
[*] We have made it so the Season Pass XP is now moved to the world in 3D. When you kill a zombie, the text will fly off of it with how much XP you've received. 
[*] Fixed the Battle Royale and Competitive XP for playtime not being given. 
[*] Fixed a major bug when placing vehicles down. It will now head wherever you're heading. 
[*] Decreased the accuracy for Bandit AI's in close combat situations. 
[*] Increased the accuracy for AI's in Warm-up Servers when in long-distance situations. 
[*] We have disabled controller support as default as they can cause conflict. You can still enable it through the in-game menu. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the Laser Particles with users who have AMD GPUs. 
[*] You can no longer pick up vehicles if the trunk is not empty. 
[*] Fixed various bugs with the vehicles.
[/list]
More information

[list]
[*] Improved the physics model for the Airport Tower. You can no longer climb out of the window. 
[*] Increased the render distance of the oil container that would cause problems when players hid behind it.
[*] Fixed some localization mistakes in Turkish. 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 5.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
We are happy to announce a great new feature that is being worked on and is ready for an early release. We will be bringing AI to Infestation! 
This is something that's long overdue and is being asked by players for a couple of years now. 
Without further ado, here is the video of our DevBlog on the new AI Bots:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PYpK4v8KhS8

[h2]GENERAL CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:[/h3][list]
[*]Added AI Bots to the game. For more details on it, watch the video above!
[list][*]AI Bots have two main categories: Bandits and Civilians.
[*]Bandits will shoot on sight and will drop loot.
[*]Civilians will be semi-passive (only attack when are attacked). They will not drop loot. They can help players moving to and from safezones against other players and against zombies.
[/list]
[*]Disabled Clan Territories in PvE Servers
[*]Updated Shadow Options
[*]DeathMatch Gamemode Prototype has been added to the game. 
[list][*]They will for now replace Warmup Servers and will have the new queue system similar to Competitive. Items are random and there is only 3 second revive time. More information on this coming soon.
[/list]
[*]Rifle Laser can be toggled on/off by pressing the Flashlight key (Default is [b]F[/b]).
[*]Fixed a major issue with sounds not playing properly when too many zombies were around you.
[*]Fixed a bug with the Missions that would cause a crash when trying to complete them.
[*]Improved the functionality of the flashlight and laser/flashlight attachments.
[/list]

[h3]COSMETICS:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Updated the Streamer Riot Shield for ETwo.
[*]Reworked the icons of the MG36 and its skinned versions.
[*]Reworked the icons of the Frying Pan and its skinned versions.

notes.title: Patch 5.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/944f99244ee74c6072d8ee69573351452b7962bd.png[/img]

[h1]GENERAL CHANGES[/h1]
[h3][b]GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:[/b][/h3][list]
[*][b]Created an interactive Tutorial for Beginners. [/b]
[i]Though this might seem uninteresting for some players, after analyzing and collecting feedback from new players, we realized that this game is unique to a level that with no prior knowledge, it is easy to get lost on basic actions and objectives in the game. With that in mind, we created an interactive game tutorial made available for everyone to learn basic things and to help players get into the idea of the game in a more organized and logical way than just throwing them into a server with no instruction. [/i]
[*]Added more in-game tips
[*]Updated the F1 Help screens.
[*]Fixed a bug that would allow players to buy Premium even when they had Lifetime Premium.
[*]Fixed an issue with the bus stop that would cause you to be stuck inside the structure after traveling. 
[*]Added scrolling when you hover item names. 
[*]You can now have up to five missions active in your HUD. The mission objectives on the right side are now collapsed. You can scroll between the missions by pressing a button (Default is [b],[/b](COMMA)). 
[*]Fixed an issue that would cause all key bindings to be reset whenever we added a new key option.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/d4141931dfc33c4c48b4e285d21891d34ccdfd7c.jpg[/img]

[*]Updated the Streamer Riot Shield for ETwo. 
[*]Reworked the icons of the [b]MP5[/b] and its skinned versions. 
[*]Reworked the icons of the [b]M40A1[/b] and its skinned versions. 
[*]Reworked the icons of the [b]EVO-3 [/b]and its skinned versions. 
[*]Reworked the icons of the [b]Golf Club[/b] and its skinned versions.

[*]Reworked the icons of the [b]Baseball Bat[/b] and its skinned versions.

[*]Fixed the bad icons for the[b] K. Style NVG[/b].
[*]Fixed the animation of the [b]M9 Bayonet[/b] knife.
[/list]

[h2][b]ARCADE[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]GENERAL CHANGES & FIXES[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Random Spawns have been fixed on Event Servers. 
[*]Removed a few misplaced objects around and in the airport.
[/list]

[h2][b]SURVIVAL[/b][/h2]

notes.title: Patch 4.9
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/abcde4448bd6babe4d1b30c4a9ef646ff662031b.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]GENERAL CHANGES
[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Clan invites now show you who invited you to the clan. 
[*]Fixed a bug causing vehicles to not respawn. 
[*]Added Trunk Storage to vehicles. They will have a similar system to the Personal Locker, but on wheels! Each vehicle has a different amount of slots and no weight restrictions. 
[*]Fixed a bug that would allow players to shoot their Shotguns inside safezones (it still did no damage to other players). 
[*]Fixed a bug that causes the player to get stuck on random objects forcing the player to jump.
[*]Fixed a building with some windows you could walk through from the inside. 
[*]Removed 4th of July Missions and Content.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Airport Towers where you would be able to shoot through the walls. 
[*]Zombie Damage from Flashlight has been increased.
[*]Fixed the missing model from the Amphetamine vaccine.
[*]M40A1 Remington 700 can now hold 5 bullets.
[/list]

[h3][b]SERVER CHANNELS REWORK:[/b]
[/h3]In order to better categorize and organize all our game modes with their subtypes (such as PVP, or Warmup in Arcade) we have restructured the internal layout. This will make future game mode or sub-game mode updates more reliable and faster to develop. Players should not notice any difference on how the server browsing works.
 
[h1]SURVIVAL[/h1]

[h3][b]GENERAL CHANGES[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Statistics previously not counted will now count towards the Top 1-10 Skins. 
[*]When selecting Survival, you will not be prompted with the same screen as in Arcade, where you can choose which kind of servers you'd like to view. They will be limited to Official, Private and Premium Servers. 
[*]Changed the weight of the Armor Plates from 3.0kg to 1.5kg. 
[*]Added more collision walls around the Airport. [/list]



[h1]BATTLE ROYALE[/h1]

[h2]REWORK[/h2]
We are doing some changes to the Battle Royale mode and its systems. 
Here are a few things we will be changing:[list]
[*][b]Battle Royale Server code has been rewritten[/b]
[i][b]Note from the developer:[/b] The Battle Royale gamemode was created back in 2016, designed as a mini gamemode in mind. This made it extremely hard to work on, add features or fix bugs. It has now been recoded as a real gamemode, giving us more control over any of it's features and/or optimizations.[/i]
[*][b]Reworked Radiation System:[/b] The Radiation system has been reworked in order to become more dynamic and smarter. It will start at a random area on the map, then will decrease within it. However, it will not be reduced exactly in the center. It will be randomly placed inside the new area. 
That will prevent players from being able to know exactly where the center will be when the match starts. 
[*][b]Changed some UI elements and sounds:[/b] To reflect the changes with the radiation, the UI elements that display radiation on the minimaps and some sounds have been adjusted to match the new system.
[/list]

[h2]GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES[/h2]
Statistics previously not counted will now count towards the Top 1-10 Skins, including previous.
Fixed a bug playing the airdrop sound in Battle Royale when a airdrop is opened by a player.

[h2]MAPS[/h2]
[h3]TROPICO (REWORK)[/h3]
In addition to the major changes to the whole BR System, the Tropico map has gone through a rework as well. [list]
[*]Loot and loot placement has been improved.
[*]Made changes to the level design to make it easier to survive and protect yourself with hills and buildings.[/list]

[h1]COMPETITIVE[/h1]

[h3]Warmup queue[/h3][list]
[*]Added a Warmup Server for players waiting for a competitive match. 
[*]They work similar to the Battle Royale queue system.[/list]

notes.title: Patch 4.6
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/54380f0cac297272a8b04b17f64867af395c5239.png[/img]

[h2]GENERAL CHANGES[/h2]

[h3][b]GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug on the launcher that would cause it to freeze on loading when you pressed PLAY before the launcher was ready.
[*]You can now invite/accept invites others while on death screen.
[*]Added a Files Repair System on the standalone launcher.
[*]Reorganized the Options Menu with links to the sub-sections.
[*]Fixed a bug with the Unstuck Vehicle function that would cause vehicles to fly.
[*]Fixed an issue with Physics on the parking lot.
[*]Fixed an issue that would cause your car to be stuck on zombies when you tried running over them.
[*]Fixed an issue that would cause a sound corruption when there were too many different sounds playing around you.
[*]Improved the SSAO option. It now has a better quality but a lower performance impact. 
[*]SSAO also improves the grass now.
[*]Reloading a weapon will no longer desync when switching from First-Person to Third-Person or vice-versa.
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause players to go under the ground when exiting a vehicle.

[/list]



[h2]ITEM CHANGES[/h2]

[h3][b]SHOTGUNS REWORK:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]New types of ammo for shotguns have been added. The following are new types and their effects:[table][th][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/4cde95c1c2d8a4d7ce61f39b7d37b4396acc5b07.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/361cc8936519f98b6870a74cb572af096821ba56.png[/img][/url] [/th]
[th][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/58c6efd23872fc939516c5f2e847ddb61e727d11.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/7289d1bbf9ee4ccc5cbcdb660fb4f8830799f1c0.png[/img][/url][/th]
[th][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/2476c389c34a263dca90563ee5e6106f4b662cd0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/c4f69ba880e7fee588b2768a68a655e612dee58c.png[/img][/url][/th]
[th][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/9a211bf11c468a9e524ffb3b4b8492a5533b803c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/7cf7c7892bf1b66fca58adacea6a4ea1c86691ba.png[/img][/url][/th][/table]
[list]
[*][b]Flechette[/b]: Our current shells. Damage is slightly decreased. 
[*][b]Slugs[/b] (MEDIUM-RARE): More range, less spread. 
[*][b]Magnum[/b] (RARE): More damage, longer ranger and higher recoil. 
[/list]
[*]Shotguns will now only reload the ammo missing from the clip. Shotguns are now able to shoot mid-reload if there is more than 1 bullet.
[/list]

[h2]ARCADE[/h2]

[h3][b]FIXES & CHANGES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem on the parking lot building that is mainly placed in Caliwood.
[/list]

[h3][b]MAPS[/b][/h3]
[b][u]Colorado v2[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the Clan Territory flag located in Glenwood Springs.
[*]Added Collision Walls around some building roofs.
[*]Fixed a player spawn at Glenwood Springs.
[/list]

[b][u]Caliwood[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the LOD for some buildings, including the Hospital.
[*]Fixed missing parts from buildings in their LOD.
[/list]


[h2]SURVIVAL[/h2]

[h3][b]FIXES & ADDITIONS[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Re-balanced the loot on the L-Shaped buildings
[*]Added item crates around the maps
[*]Adjusted the LOD loading Distance for small tres
[/list]

[h3][b]LOOT UPDATE[/b][/h3]
[i]We are constantly working together with players to make the loot tables are as good as we can but we also should not forget, this is Survival and not an AR-Only Arcade mode.[/i][list]
[*]Buffed military loot overall
[*]Thirdend places will now spawn thirdend item types. For example Camp Splinter in Colorado has a higher chance of attachments.
[*]Battery has been removed from the loot tables.
[/list]

[h3][b]MAPS[/b][/h3]
[b][u]Oregon[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some terrain issues next to the prison.[/list]

[b][u]Colorado[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Removed some misplaced flying objects around Crystal Lake Resort.
[*]Added more cover spots to the north of Clearview.[/list]

[h2]BATTLE ROYALE[/h2]

[h3][b]FIXES & ADDITIONS[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Damage from radiation is increased the longer you are in it.
[*]New Skinbox for Battle Royale. Release will happen any time after the patch.
[/list]

notes.title: [HOTFIX] Patch 4.4
notes.notes:
Some issues may have occurred with the new skilltree system and this hotfix should address them all. 

[h2]OVERALL CHANGES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a Reset button to the skill tree. You can reset your skills at any given time to redistribute it. 
[*] Lowered the overall amount of EXP required for a full skill tree.
[i] Don't worry, hardcore farmers/PVE, we will be adding more skills in the future focused solely on PVE.[/i]
[*] Added the missing levels to the Zombie Melee Damages.
[*] Increased the gain on the Stamina Skill Tree.
[*] Improved the loot from the Blue Medic Crates (both on Survival and Arcade).
[*] Damage done to the hand is lower than body damage now.
[*] Improved the [b]XMR-32[/b] Sniper and tweaked it. Since it's an extremely rare sniper, we feel it should be better than others.

notes.title: PATCH 4.4
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26931738/082ffd0aaf56ad47b992cb84aab2e88f52925015.png[/img]

[h3][b][u]SUMMARY[/u][/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New Skill Tree System
[*] Physics improvements
[*] Netcode update
[*] Major performance improvement in servers
[*] Mission bugs fixed
[*] 1vs1 Map added
[*] Classic Lounge is back
[*] Revive bug in BR fixed
[/list]


[h2][b][u]GENERAL CHANGES[/u][/b][/h2]

[b][h3]USER INTERFACES AND MENUS:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some mistakes in the Spanish Localization
[*] Fixed some mistakes in the Russian Localization
[/list]

[h3][b]GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

[b][h3]Skill Tree Rework[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] We are releasing a new and more complete skill tree. This skill tree will require much more EXP but it will give you much more benefits. 
[*] Skills that have similar effects will have more levels and are grouped together, but you don't need to complete all level in order to progress. 
[*] There are some new skills that can be helpful as well. 
[*] To get a full skill tree you will need roughly 35 million EXP. However, to get the same skills as you currently have (as the previous full skill tree) you will need around the same. So choose where to place your skill points wisely. 
[*] All the skill points have been reset on all characters but your EXP is still there. 
[/list]
[h3][b]OTHER CHANGES AND FIXES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused skinned items to have invalid/unused firemodes.
[*] Reworked the Weapon Restriction Option for Server owners. It's much simpler and more understandable.
[*] Optimized Zombies. Instead of lagging the whole game for you when loads of zombies die at once, the animation will be slowed down, that way the FPS will remain unaffected.
[*] Physics engine will now run at 60 fps, rather than 30. That means animations of server sided objects (grenades, zombies, items dropping) will be much smoother. 
[*] PhysX will now use more cores from your CPU (up to 4 instead of 2). This will be on higher end systems. This will improve overall performance when around many players/zombies/items.
[*] The grenade throwing system has been reworked for a smoother experience. 
[*] Updated the Netcode. Player movement should feel smoother now.
[*] Fixed a bug with some custom Riot Shields not having animation. 
[*] Fixed a major bug that caused servers with 50+ players to lag.
[*] Fixed a major bug with missions not loading correctly after a game updated.
[/list]


[h2][b][u]ITEM CHANGES[/u][/b][/h2]

[h3][b]ADDITIONS & CHANGES:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Heavy Armor, K. Style and K. Style NVG skins for ranks 2-10.

[/*]	[*]		Fixed some physics issues on the maps.	[/*]	[*]		Added "Overgrowth" back to buildings in Survival.	[/*][/list]

You can access it by pressing on the icon [u][b] ? [/b][/u] or by pressing [b]F1.[/b]	[/*]	[*]		Fixed some localization in some languages.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a few UI bugs in Battle Royale. For most of you, you won't feel much of a difference, but  disconnecting randomly from VOIP will be greatly decreased.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		Double-clicking in the inventory will now use/equip/attach an item (you can disable that option from the Options Menu)	[/*]	[*]		Added an option to add "Winter Mode" to your private servers. [/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue with eating food that could remove your shield.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed an issue with Competitive Matches not starting in Oceania	[/*][/list]

[list]	[*]		Added a few new Airdrop types. More information soon.	[/*]	[*]		Reworked the icon for a few items:		[list]			[*]				AR Barrel			[/*]			[*]				Sniper Barrel			[/*]			[*]				AR Stock			[/*]			[*]				Sniper Stock			[/*]			[*]				Snow Man Barricade			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		Changed the damage from the Karambit. notes.notes:

notes.title: Patch 3.9
notes.notes:
[b]SUMMARY:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Tweaked the Friends List, especially with the Steam friends list that could cause many minor issues. 	[/*]	[*]		Made some changes to the Slicer zombie.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a lot of bugs related to zombies. 	[/*]	[*]		Make some tweaks on weapons to balance them out better. 	[/*]	[*]		Players will no longer respawn inside "events".	[/*]	[*]		Made some adjustments to the zombie optimization systems.	[/*]	[*]		Made some changes to the secret rooms so they can't be abused and you can't risk finding empty crates.	[/*]	[*]		Made some tweaks to the contracts in Survival.	[/*]	[*]		Adjusted spawns around Clearview and added cover.	[/*][/list]
	[b]Full Patch Notes:[/b]

	[u][b]GENERAL CHANGES[/b][/u]

	[b]USER INTERFACES AND MENUS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Added more options for server owners on the Private Server panel.	[/*]	[*]		Added a warning to the Flea Market in offers where weapons or ammo are not full. 	[/*]	[*]		Tweaked the Friend system to avoid lags from huge friends lists. 	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a UI bug in the Arcade Leaderboards that could cause a game crash.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug that causes the crafting screen to incorrectly show that the recipe required a workbench.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug that caused item descriptions to not show properly. 	[/*]	[*]		Added an option to toggle Steam friends on/off.	[/*][/list]
	[b]GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:[/b]
[list]	[*]		The icon for the Airdrop will disappear after the Airdrop is looted.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug where the reviver time would go to 0 (visually) when you purchased something in the shop. 	[/*]	[*]		The Slicer Zombie will no longer chase vehicles.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug that caused zombies not to be able to attack targets that were slightly higher than the zombies.	[/*]	[*]		Players will no longer respawn inside Radiation areas. 	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a kick that was caused due to sliding downhills. 	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug that caused skinned items to not be counted as a crafting item resource. 	[/*]	[*]		Made some changes to how the Secret Rooms work. From now on, you use the cards to open the crates rather than the door.	[/*]	[*]		Heli Crashes [u][b]will not[/b] [/u]instantly spawn zombies upon appearing on the map. 	[/*]	[*]		You cannot use a gauze accidentally if you are not bleeding. 	[/*]	[*]		Lowered interaction time on Lockers.	[/*]	[*]		Adjusted the sounds of Zombie Dogs to make it easier to detect their direction.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug that caused the Slicer Zombie to respawn too quickly. 	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug where other players' weapons would show incorrectly when aiming down.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug that caused zombies to glitch when dying and reappearing "frozen" in place. 	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a bug on the server where they would lag for a second every 5 minutes and zombies would teleport around. 	[/*]	[*]		Reworked zombie optimizations: 		[list]			[*]				To improve general performance a while back, we made some changes to the animation and their AI when they were far. We have fixed a few bugs related to this which will make them feel much smoother.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		M4:		[list]			[*]				Spread has been slightly increased			[/*]			[*]				Recoil has been slightly increased			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		AKM:		[list]			[*]				Spread has been slightly increased			[/*]			[*]				Recoil has been slightly increased			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		FN Scar CQC:		[list]			[*]				Speed has been slightly decreased			[/*]			[*]				Fire rate has been slightly decreased			[/*]			[*]				Spread has been slightly decreased			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		FN Scar Nightstalker:		[list]			[*]				Fire rate has been slightly increased			[/*]			[*]				Spread has been slightly decreased			[/*]			[*]				Recoil has been slightly increased			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		AK-47:		[list]			[*]				Speed has been slightly increased			[/*]			[*]				Spread has been slightly decreased			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		AN94:		[list]			[*]				Spread has been slightly increased			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]
	 

	[u][b]ITEM CHANGES[/b][/u]

	[b]MODELS[/b][u][b]:[/b][/u]
[list]	[*]		Made some changes to the ladder models. This will prevent you from getting stuck on top.	[/*]	[*]		Fixed a material issue on the Zombie Spike.	[/*][/list]
	 

	[b]SKINS:[/b]
[list]	[*]		[b]Fixes[/b]		[list]			[*]				Fixed the Light Sword Yellow. It was previously showing the wrong color. 			[/*]		[/list]	[/*][/list]

notes.title: INFESTATION: SURVIVOR STORIES IS BACK!
notes.notes:
INFESTATION: SURVIVOR STORIES IS BACK!

We're giving a fresh start to everyone who purchased I:SS in the past!

[previewyoutube=EdFXsbznssc;full][/previewyoutube]

Our goal is to bring you the same type of gameplay that you enjoyed in I:SS together with the many new features, content & bug fixes we have done over the years, including new zombies, alien zombies, random map events like Airdrops with loot, helicopter crashes infested with the dead and military grade weaponry and radiation zones where you won't be able to breath without proper tools.

A new flea market where you can sell your items for in-game currency.

All fixes and tweaks we've made over years on the game and a new UI to better suit all your needs.

All that topped up with a functional and top-of-the-market Anticheat exclusively developed for the game and engine!

Come join the good times where survival is your main goal! Fight zombies and players alike and try to get through each night!

The game will of course be free-to-play, if you do not own Infestation: Survivor Stories 2020 on Steam, you can simply join it through Survival on Infestation: The New Z:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/555570/Infestation_The_New_Z/

notes.title: INFESTATION SURVIVOR STORIES REBOOT
notes.notes:
Dear players,

This is the Swedish development team at Fredaikis speaking. Since 2015 we have been developing the title "Infestation: The New Z" which is based on I:SS code but targeted more towards PvP where loot is much more easily obtained compared to old I:SS.
This has become very popular among many players, but there's still a big part of you who are asking us almost on a daily basis to adapt The New Z more to what I:SS used to be in terms of gameplay and loot.

We have therefore in the past months been doing exactly so, reworking loot and gameplay on our "Survival" mode in New Z aimed to be just like in classic I:SS and have asked OP Productions for permission to release it for everyone who in the past purchased Infestation: Survivor Stories on Steam.

On the 15th of October we are therefore wiping the Survival mode in New Z, replacing the loot tables with the new ones that we have been working on in the past months, giving everyone a fresh start at equal conditions. The game will of course be free-to-play.

Our goal is to bring you the same type of gameplay that you enjoyed in I:SS together with the many new features, content & bug fixes we have done over the years, including new zombies, alien zombies, random map events like Airdrops with loot, helicopter crashes infested with the dead and military grade weaponry and radiation zones where you won't be able to breath without proper tools. 
A new flea market where you can sell your items for in-game currency
All fixes and tweaks we've made over years on the game and a new UI to better suit all your needs.
All that topped up with a functional and top-of-the-market Anticheat exclusively developed for the game and engine!
Come join the good times where survival is your main goal! Fight zombies and players alike and try to get through each night!
We hope to see you on the 15th of October!

Best Wishes from the Fredaikis Team

notes.title: I:SS CLASSIC END OF SERVICE ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We regret to inform you that Infestation Survivor Stories Classic will officially shut down December 15th, 2016.  ISS Classic will continue to operate up until this date but as of midnight all servers will be shut down permanently.  All GC purchase options have already been disabled, and the game is no longer available for purchase on Steam.  

It has been a wild 4 year ride of full of memories and amazing gaming experiences but unfortunately the game is no longer able to sustain enough players to keep itself online.  We are very grateful for the awesome community we have and all of your suggestions and feedback that helped make this game a place many players were proud to call home for many years.  We urge all players to spend any remaining GC balances they may have and try to have as much fun as you can before the servers are shut down.  Thanks for all the wonderful memories everyone :)

While ISS Classic is no more - it’s legacy is carried on! We are proud to present Infestation: NewZ - an official re-work of Infestation: Survivor Stories, created by new independent developers. Team up with your friends and participate in the best Zombie PvP MMO experience that also features a wide selection of different game modes. Best of all? Its free-to-play!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/555570/


-OP Productions Publishing Team
